input is null before INPUT_DISPATCHED and engine-specific afterwards; completed input requires mask 7 or returned true
an incomplete input phase requires CDP cause MOVE/PRESS/RELEASE with mask 0/1/3 respectively, or PW_CLICK_REJECTED with returned false

terminal plus pending equals requests; captures never exceeds terminal; mutations never exceeds requests
sourceCommit fixtureId engine and scenario bind to the supervisor and original source; no arbitrary paths are accepted
